SV0298 उत्तरायण/आदान काल uttarāyaṇa/ādāna kāla Ascent of sun or northward movement of sun. this movement reduces the moisture (Saumya) from the earth, even it takes out the strength from living beings. Śiśira, Vasanta & Grișma ŗtu together constitute Uttarāyana which brings about reduction of strength.
RS0245 उत्तरीय uttarīya Resembles sacred thread wore by Brahmans in India, generally wore by brāhmins
SR0359 उत्तरोष्ठ uttaroṣṭha Upper lip or labium. upper half of soft external structure that forms the boundary of the mouth.
